Flavor_Text: A senior spots you at MT looking entirely burnt out and buys you a cold coffee. Hearing 'everyone fails this course' drops your stress instantly.
You overslept for an 8 AM lecture, but a wingmate clutched the proxy. You saved your attendance, but completely missed the core concepts.
The wing decides to pirate a movie at 2 AM. You sacrifice a block of time, but pure, unadulterated bonding restores your mind.
You find someone in the PKK Library who actually understands the assignment. A highly productive, collaborative session ensues.
You offer to pay for the group's Maggi at the Hall Canteen. It costs you a little pocket money, but the goodwill is worth it.
The paneer from the night canteen betrayed you. You lose a time block to the washroom and feel utterly drained.
The professor walks in, locks the doors, and writes two questions on the board. You were not ready.
Club politics spill over into the hostel wing. You spend an hour mediating a fight that shouldn't even exist.
You are running late to LHC and your cycle tire goes flat. You have to pay the repair shop and walk the rest of the way.
Your code was compiling perfectly until the screen went blue. The pure panic of losing unsaved progress takes years off your life.
A package arrives from home. Snacks, cash, and a letter. For a moment, you forget about the mid-sems.
You walk past the OAT and someone is playing a guitar. You sit on the grass for an hour and just breathe.
The oscilloscope in your bay is fried. You waste a time block waiting for the TA to find a replacement.
After staring at the same proof for an hour, the logic suddenly clicks. A massive wave of relief and understanding washes over you.
The administration declares a sudden holiday due to intense heat. The collective sigh of relief from the student body is deafening.
